en: Rocus... Please, protect the world. And be a help to the angel...
You are...?
Let me treat you...
No, there is no need... To wither away here is also my fate...
Why... I have these hands... and I still can't save her...
You must be one of the angel's heroes...
Don't glare at me with such a scary face. I'm one of the heroes too.
You're hurt, aren't you? I can treat you if you like.
...Really?
I'm a priest, as you can see. I can't just leave someone in trouble.
I see... Then please...
This power...?
Oh... it's nothing special.
Thank you. I owe you.
No need for thanks. I'll send the angel the bill for the offering.
Heh... You're an odd one.
So I'm told. Well, if the chance comes, we'll meet again.
Sir Mage, in trouble again, are we?
Rocus... wasn't it?
That's right. And you were Fein or some such, I believe. The angel told me before, but I can't quite recall.
I'll lend you a hand. ＄＄＄＄＄＄ wants it too.
To be saved by you so many times... I owe you one.
Well, keep up the good fight.
I'm not one for fighting, you see. I need people like you to do their best.
Understood...
This time I won't say we'll meet again. Goodbye, Sir Mage.
You're one of the angel's heroes.
...Who are you?
A priest, as you can see. As a fellow hero of the angel, I'll help you.
...There's no need.
Now, now, don't act tough. Besides, it's nothing much.
What are you going to do?
It'll only take a moment...
Your wounds should be healed.
...Thanks.
No thanks needed. ...By the way, have we met somewhere before?
No, I don't think so.
I see... My mistake, then... Oh well. We'll meet again somewhere.
Yeah. Thanks for that...
You...
We meet again.
I don't intend to trouble anyone.
The angel sent me. There's no point in lying there unable to move forever.
Don't act tough.
Well, if you want to protect your pride, get stronger...
I know how you feel, though...
See you.
...Who are you?
A priest. I serve the angel, same as you.
What do you want?
Don't act tough. Let me see that wound.
It won't take long.
What... My wounds are healed? Is that magic?
Who knows? Something like it.
Thanks... What's your name?
Rocus.
I'll pay you back someday.
I did it of my own accord. No thanks needed.
Well, if fate allows, we'll meet again.
Rocus... I messed up again...
Let me see.
Sorry. For the trouble...
It's nothing. Just be more careful next time.
Letting a cute girl do something so dangerous... ＄＄＄＄＄＄ is cruel.
Who are you?
I'm a hero of the angel, just like you. My name is Rocus Las Flores.
Let me heal your wounds.
? My wounds are gone...
Would you tell me your name, miss?
I-Irene... Thank you...
I can't leave a lady in trouble, after all.
No need for thanks. Please be careful from now on.
Irene, are you all right?
The priest from before?
Yes, it's Rocus. Show me your wounds. I'll treat them.
Thank you. You've helped me so many times...
Not at all. I'm glad we met. I could be of help.
I'll have a word with ＄＄＄＄＄＄ too. Not to push a girl so hard.
Farewell.
You're one of the angel's heroes, aren't you?
...Who are you?
I'm a hero of the angel, just like you.
Would you let me see your wounds? I may be able to do something.
Excuse me.
That should do it. How do you feel?
It's true... Thank you... What is your name?
I didn't think anyone would help a person of the Empire, so I was suspicious of you.
Forgive me, Rocus.
Think nothing of it. I was able to help a beauty like you.
The next time we meet, let's share a meal.
Are you all right, Leyla-sama?
Rocus...
I think you'd better not push yourself so hard.
...Thank you, Rocus. I've troubled you so many times.
No, it's quite all right.
It's just that I can't bear to see a beauty like you hurt any longer.
Red blood doesn't suit that golden hair. Please take care of yourself.
You...
Are you all right? I'm worried about your wounds. Let me see.
...I'm sorry to trouble you.
Not at all. This is nothing.
Thank you so much...
No thanks needed. Let's both take care. The fighting isn't over yet...
Yes... You take care too.
The Empire's witch... I have to stop you here.
I know you're the root of all this.
Hahaha, you can't stop me.
Wrong... I came to defeat you.
You seem to be rambling on about something, but I'm not interested in your words.
Let's get this fight over with.
Rocus!!!
The dragon left for another world, and the chaos that had shrouded the world cleared like a mist.
Once again the world began quietly to mark time, and the heroes each went their own way in life.
Cecia, the girl of the forest, returned to her homeland.
The deep blue forest had not changed at all, yet to the grown-up Cecia it felt far more precious than before.
The forest embraced and protected everything, but she knew that even this world of the forest would not last forever.
One day the forest would be joined to the world outside, and they could not go on living within it alone.

Whenever the children of the forest begged for stories of the outside world, she told them vividly what it was like: stone buildings taller than trees, markets crowded with more people than you could count, food no one had ever seen.
And at the end she always told them that the people outside were no different from them, people who loved peace and their families just the same.
The little children always listened with shining eyes.
Cecia never stopped praying that when the children one day widened their world, their future would be peaceful and rich.
To the people and the world I love, all my tenderness, forever...
Satan's dragon was gone, and peace had returned to Arcaya, the world below...
It feels as if a long time has passed since I left their land...
In a world still scarred by the dragon's claws and the chaos, they each took a new step forward.
Cecia went back to the Forest of Reyforia. With St. Diana's return, the forest was overjoyed.
For a while, I imagine, her days were spent making reports to the elders and talking with everyone who came to visit Cecia.

Then, when the excitement faded and she was alone, she seems to have gone to the Forest of the Holy Mother to think about what lay ahead. Lost quietly in thought, perhaps she can see the forest of the future.
I will keep praying that when the forest one day mingles with the outside world... it will be a wonderful thing for the forest and for her...
Again and again I recall the days I spent with them, and the memories shine.
I am grateful from the bottom of my heart that I met them.
O small star of the great light... May tenderness and great blessings be upon everyone who lives there, upon all of the world I love...
Back from her journey, Cecia did not return to the forest of her homeland but to the Forest of the Holy Mother.
She seemed to feel that something of hers still remained there.
It was a lonely life, but protecting the forest meant more to her than anything.
Like many Holy Mothers before her, she lived there until she grew old,
praying for the peace of the world.
Her prayers embraced the world, forever and ever...
Clive Saingrent: the days of fighting his own blood were over, and peace came to his heart.
From a life wandering through cold nights to a world bathed in warm sunlight. The breath of life in all its forms, unlike anything he had felt before, enfolded him anew.
Now that the world and he himself were as they should be, he looked for a new path to live by.
He chose to hone his swordsmanship, and lived as a mercenary knight, fighting for what he believed in.
The life of travelling the world with his comrades became the best days of his life.
The years went by, and for his deeds he became lord of a small country. In that small, peaceful land he was loved by the people as a ruler of heart and courage.
What he had sought, and what had been sought of him, he found, and he lived out his life to the full.
Clive seems to have shaken off the temptation of blood and to be trying to live in the sunlight.
Through the journey to save the world he must have looked hard at himself, and thought long about what it means to live cursing yourself.
